authorityBoundary: R0 consolidates approved evidence only. It does not authorize R1 isolated infrastructure provisioning, target write, migration authoring, DDL, DML, seed, application-data access, credential, grant, deployment, recovery, or production action.

verification.verificationMethod: Read and SHA-256 compare every manifest-listed tracked artifact against its frozen path, byte count, and digest on the merged CB-1-CB-3 source lineage.

r1HardStop: R1 is not authorized. No disposable target, network resource, credential, grant, application route, runner, environment, or infrastructure design action may begin without a distinct owner authorization.
